As we battled our own demons (not the exhilarating kind we pursue in-game!), we remained steadfast in refining our creation to deliver an even more gripping experience. Anticipate updates on our ongoing demon-hunting escapades! 🎮👾💥

May your victories be grand, battles bold, 🏆🔥

A New Year filled with triumphs firsthand! 🎉💪
Action-packed days, victories bright, 🌟🎉
May the New Year bring gaming delight! 🎮✨"[/b]

We are actively working on improving optimization through DLSS for Nvidia 20+ series cards and FSR for AMD cards. This optimization extends to Nvidia 10+ series cards as well, significantly boosting FPS by 50% to even 150%, depending on the player's hardware setup. FSR also functions seamlessly on Nvidia 10+ series cards, providing enhanced performance for a broader range of players.

[list]
[*] Introducing DLSS support exclusively for Nvidia 20+ series graphics cards, ensuring smoother and more immersive visuals for supported hardware. 🖥️✨

[*] Embrace the power of FSR, available for both AMD and Nvidia 10+ graphics cards, unlocking a substantial FPS boost of 50% to 150% across various hardware configurations. 🚀🎮

[*] Experience minor AI improvements, enhancing the game's overall intelligence for more engaging encounters. 🤖🔧

[*] We've also dedicated efforts to resolve minor environmental bugs, ensuring a seamless and polished gameplay environment. 🌍🐛
[/list]

Prepare for these improvements and stay tuned for an update that's geared towards maximizing performance and delivering a more refined gameplay experience! 🎮✨

[b]Announcing a 50% discount on our game until January 6, 2024! Join the demon-hunting action at an unbeatable price. [/b]🎮👾💥

[b]And that's not all! Stay tuned for a discounted price during the upcoming FPS Steam Fest. Don't miss out on another chance to grab Bloodhound at a great price! [/b]🎉🔥

Thank you for standing by us! Dive into the game fearlessly and take on every challenge with confidence! 🙌💫

notes.title: What's new and what's coming!
notes.content:
Hello demon hunters!

We apologize for the temporary lack of contact from our side. We are constantly working on improvements to the Bloodhound game!

The free retro DLC will be launched in the coming days, there will be a temporary trailer on the store page. We are doing so in order not to delay the publication. In the coming weeks, this trailer will be replaced with a proper one! o7

Retro DLC will also be available for the demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42192124/6c052f32b87b9593d32b362c73c54ff962f3249d.jpg[/img]

Patch 1.2.2 will be available in the coming days. It will be added in it:

To the full version of the game:

- Improved performance of ragdolls, now on inclines and stairs characters will not hang in the air after death.

- Adding a list of people dropping in credits and thanks.

- Improved ragdoll will also be added to the game demo.

- Improved collision detection for flying units

- And other minor improvements.

We are also immediately preparing patch 1.3, which will significantly change the feeling of moving and shooting, and the changes it introduces will be as follows.

- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for movement.
- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for sprinting
- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for dashing

- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for revolver shooting
- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for shotgun shooting

- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for minigun
- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for railgun
- Adding camera work on rotation, translation and FOV for chainsaw

- LOD improved system: better optimization on older PCs

- Translated options from key rebinding

In patch 1.3.1 we will add a plot element appearing at the beginning of the game in the form of a short comic book to better introduce and outline the storyline that happens in the game. So that it is not only at the end of the game that an enigmatic plot element appears suggesting the storyline.

Below is an excerpt from the comic in draft form.

notes.title: Project news and temporary deactivation of the demo
notes.content:
Hello Demon Hunters o/.

Work on the Bloodhound project is in full swing. 

- We've replaced most of the weapon animations,
- We have redesigned the UX and UI along with the Player HUD. 
- We are adding new VFXs, 
- We improved the optimizations even more,
- We added a lot of cool details to the enviroment to make it look even nicer. 
- Our Sound Designers worked on the juiciness of the gun firing.
- We rebalanced weapons and enemies: adding range attacks to some melee enemies
- We have completely redesigned one enemy. Blood Priestess of Astaroth making a purely magic damage character into a supportive damage character. Now the opponents have gained additional support against the player. The priestess seems inconspicuous but left unattended she can mess up a lot during a fight. 
- We have also increased the number of ambients in the game to improve climate building during breaks between fights.
- All the time we are working on improving the AI and its behavior in a group.

As you can see, we are not idle. All the time we are vigorously polishing our beloved project. A large number of changes over the past few months means that we have to temporarily deactivate the demo on Steam. It does not reflect the current technical state. Soon we will also change the library of screenshots and upload a new trailer. 

When we finish work on the 3rd version of the demo. Now the final one. In it you will get to play part of the first act of the game and a lot of other new things. 

We apologize for the silence on our part so far. The work on polishing the project: Bloodhound consumes us completely, so that we are able to forget about the existing world.

Best regards,
Bloodhound team.
From Players to Players o7

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes 10/05/2022 - uploaded[/b]
- Added headshots.
- Added exploding heads.
- Cupid's eyes no longer glow after death.
- Fixed wall border decals and broken wall decals.
- Body count fix.

[b]Patch Notes 14/04/2022 - uploaded[/b]
- Enemies waves balance changed.
- Enemies react to being shot by the player (animation of receiving damage).
- Motion Blur effect has been turned off.
- Opponents won’t stop chasing and attacking the player if the player crouches on the edge of the balcony.
- The player now immediately picks up two weapons (Barreled Harpoon Shotgun, Assault Rifle)
- Increased the harpoon hit area (Barreled Harpoon Shotgun alternative RMB fire).
- The bodies of the opponents don’t disappear from the arena immediately.
- The player character doesn’t get stuck on the edges of balconies if he is crouching.
- Dead enemies don’t glow red.

[b]Patch Notes 05/04/2022 - uploaded[/b]
- No interaction with the menu while displaying the opening boards.
- Opening boards can be skipped.
- Enemies turn faster.
- Cultist Berserker dashes faster to the player.
- Blade Dancer does not block projectiles while she is in the air
- Changed game difficulty balance.

[b]Patch Notes 04/04/2022 - uploaded[/b]
- Enemy Bishop is now more visible during battle.
- Added a warning of visual effects that may trigger an epileptic seizure.
- The player starts with an equipped revolver.
- Jumppads have an improved collision sphere (jumping between balconies is now more responsive).
- Enemy Cultist Berserker doesn’t get up if he is killed.

[b]Patch Notes 01/04/2022 - uploaded[/b]
- Corrected the collision of the veins.
- Added VFX for Blade Dancer to increase the visibility of the deflect missile phase.
- Game loading should now be more efficient.
- Fixed textures loading.

From Players to Players o7
